scripts.install:all: npm install && cd angular-app && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:angular && cp -r server dist/
scripts.start: npm run build:angular && node -r newrelic --env-file=.env server/start.js
scripts.dev:watch: npm run build:angular && concurrently "cd angular-app && npm run build -- --watch" "nodemon --env-file=.env server/start.js"
scripts.docker:dev:simple: echo '🚀 Starting simple development environment...' && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev-simple.yml up -d
scripts.docker:dev:full: echo '🚀 Starting full production simulation...' && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.arm64.yml up -d
scripts.docker:status: echo '📊 Docker containers status:' && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev-simple.yml ps 2>/dev/null || docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.arm64.yml ps 2>/dev/null || echo 'No containers running'
scripts.docker:logs: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev-simple.yml logs -f 2>/dev/null || docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.arm64.yml logs -f
scripts.docker:stop: echo '🛑 Stopping all Docker containers...' && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev-simple.yml down 2>/dev/null; docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.arm64.yml down 2>/dev/null; echo 'All containers stopped'
scripts.docker:clean: echo '🧹 Cleaning up Docker containers and volumes...' && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev-simple.yml down -v 2>/dev/null; docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.arm64.yml down -v 2>/dev/null; docker system prune -f; echo 'Cleanup complete'
scripts.setup:env: cp .env.example .env && echo 'Please edit .env with your actual values'
scripts.validate:env: test -f .env && echo '✅ .env file exists' || echo '❌ .env file missing - run: npm run setup:env'
scripts.db:connect:simple: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev-simple.yml exec db psql -U foodme_user -d foodme
scripts.db:connect:full: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.arm64.yml exec db psql -U foodme_user -d foodme
scripts.db:backup:simple: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev-simple.yml exec db pg_dump -U foodme_user foodme > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql
scripts.db:backup:full: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.arm64.yml exec db pg_dump -U foodme_user foodme > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql
scripts.db:restore:simple: cat backup.sql | docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev-simple.yml exec -T db psql -U foodme_user -d foodme
scripts.db:restore:full: cat backup.sql | docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.arm64.yml exec -T db psql -U foodme_user -d foodme
